title: Paranoia Chat Messages
description: A horror mod that sends random cryptic messages in your chat to make you feel watched and paranoid.
body:
Paranoia Chat Messages is a simple yet deeply unsettling Minecraft mod that slowly drives you to madness. While you play your normal survival game, cryptic messages will randomly appear in your chat — fake system errors that shouldn't exist, warnings about entities that are not registered, and whispers that somehow know your name.
Are they just glitches? Or is something actually watching you?
The messages are inspired by the atmosphere of mods like The Broken Script, blending fake Java errors, OpenGL warnings, and pure psychological horror into your chat. The longer you play, the more you will question what is real and what isn't.
Features:

Random scary messages appearing in chat at unpredictable intervals
Messages inspired by Broken Script, Cave Dweller, Herobrine and more
Fake system errors, Java exceptions and OpenGL warnings
Personalized messages that use your in-game name
Use /paranoiamessage to trigger a message instantly

Pairs perfectly with:

The Broken Script
Cave Dweller
From The Fog
Man From The Fog
And any other horror mod!

Turn off the lights. Put on your headphones. And whatever you do — don't read the messages too carefully.
